import sys, time, itertools
sys.path.insert(0,'.')
from syntax import parse_policy
from compiler.compiler import compile_policy

names = ['A'] + ['X%d'%i for i in range(1,16)]
order = names; idx = {n:i for i,n in enumerate(order)}
# distinct child-sets for depth-5 nodes: all subsets of size 1..4, then size 5 until budget
sets = []
for k in (1,2,3,4):
    sets.extend(itertools.combinations(range(16), k))
budget = 10922 - sum(len(s) for s in sets)
for s in itertools.combinations(range(16),5):
    if budget - 5 < 0: break
    sets.append(s); budget -= 5
print('sets', len(sets), 'words', sum(len(s) for s in sets))
# distinct depth-5 prefixes with distinct 4-prefixes
prefixes = []
for a in range(16):
    for b in range(16):
        for c in range(16):
            for d in range(16):
                prefixes.append((names[a],names[b],names[c],names[d],names[(a+b+c+d)%16]))
                if len(prefixes) >= len(sets): break
            if len(prefixes) >= len(sets): break
        if len(prefixes) >= len(sets): break
    if len(prefixes) >= len(sets): break
print('prefixes', len(prefixes))
words = []
for p, s in zip(prefixes, sets):
    for c in s:
        words.append(list(p) + [names[c]])
pol = ''.join('match(%s) allow;' % ','.join(w) for w in words)
print('policy bytes', len(pol), 'atoms', len(words), 'pathsyms', sum(len(w) for w in words))
t=time.time(); rules, a, p = parse_policy(pol); print('parse', round(time.time()-t,3))
t=time.time(); acc, rows, cells = compile_policy(rules, order, idx); print('compile', round(time.time()-t,3), 'rows', len(rows), 'cells', cells)
PYEOF
